name: Spatially Varying Threshold
definition: A technique to use FBM for amplifying shapes (hypertextures) by defining an isosurface $SDF(p) + B_n(p) = 0$, which is equivalent to finding the root of $B_n(p) = v(p)$ where $v(p) = -SDF(p)$. This allows using standard acceleration techniques designed for constant thresholds.
